metadata.datasource: Characteristic curves, spectral sensitivities, dye spectra from Kodak E-126E (minor revision 4-05), KODAK PROFESSIONAL ELITE Chrome Extra Color 100 Film, Process E-6, Status A. The curves were read from the vector plot, each layer by its order at the dense end, and converted from Status A densities into dye amounts. Exposure axis aligned to 'kodak_ektachrome_100' at the D-min + 1.0 speed point (offset +0.884 decades). The three layers stay as the sheet draws them on its one axis, none moved to make a grey view neutral. Past its plotted ends each sensitivity continues at its own final gradient, to three decades under its peak, and they are balanced so an 18% grey exposes every layer equally. The sheet plots no D-min spectrum: the slide's base is its D-min, the sheet's dyes in the amounts that read the curves' own D-min (R 0.17, G 0.17, B 0.14). The profile keeps the sheet's midscale neutral. No spectral adaptation window: agx fits one to each of its own stocks' sensitivities. DIR coupler model from 'kodak_ektachrome_100'.
